title: PR-context file frontmatter (`.vinta-ai-workflows/prs-context/<feature>/<phase>.md`)
description: YAML frontmatter at the top of every `.vinta-ai-workflows/prs-context/{feature-kebab}/phase-{phase.id}.md` file. Authored by `implement-plan` (and rewritten by `amend-plan`); read + updated by the bundled `open-pr.sh` script. The `# Title`, `# Description`, `# Comments` body sections that follow the frontmatter are markdown / fenced YAML and not covered by this schema; the `# Comments` YAML list has its own schema (`prs-context-comments.v1.schema.json`).

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Bumped only on breaking changes.

plan_id.description: Kebab-case identifier of the plan. Filename feature portion (strip `YYYY-MM-DD-` prefix and `_PLAN.md` suffix, lowercase).

feature_name.description: `UPPERCASE_WITH_UNDERSCORES` feature name. Matches the plan + spec filename feature portion.

kind.description: Which PR this file opens. `phase` (the default when absent): one phase's branch into its dependency-derived base. `integration`: a multi-dependency phase's `plan/<plan-id>/integ-<phase-id>` branch into the default branch, so the phase PR stacked on it can land. `plan`: the final wave branch (or, under modular commits, the plan branch) into the default branch — the PR that lands the whole plan.

phase_id.description: Phase id verbatim from the plan's `Phased Rollout` section (e.g. `1`, `4a`, `2.5`). Required unless `kind` is `plan`; for `kind: integration` it is the phase whose `integ-` branch this is.

phase_title.description: Phase title verbatim from the plan's `Phased Rollout` section. Required unless `kind` is `plan`.

branch.description: Source branch the PR opens from. `plan/<plan-id-kebab>/phase-<phase.id>` for a phase, `plan/<plan-id-kebab>/integ-<phase.id>` for an integration PR, the final `plan/<plan-id-kebab>/wave-<N>` (or `plan/<plan-id-kebab>` under modular commits) for the plan PR.

base.description: Target branch. A phase PR targets its dependency-derived base (the default branch, a dependency's phase branch, or its `integ-` branch); integration and plan PRs target the default branch.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the PR-context file was first written.

pr_url.description: URL of the published PR / MR. Populated by `open-pr.sh` on success. Empty string while `status: pending`.

allOf.description: Every PR but the plan PR belongs to one phase.
